reviews.t: Christine has been doing my hair for years, and I honestly wouldn’t trust anyone else with it! She is incredibly talented, professional, kind, and genuinely cares about her clients. She takes the time to listen to what you want and always makes sure you leave happy. I’ve seen firsthand how much pride she takes in her work and how much she cares about the people she serves. She is the kind of stylist you’re lucky to find, and I would recommend her to anyone looking for someone trustworthy, talented, and consistent. Five stars all the way!

Christine has been cutting my hair for 20 years.Two weeks ago she decided to shave half my Eyebrows off,I heard her in past laugh about doing this to another client." I left her a message of displeasure ." and instead of returning my call she left me a message about my "expression of displeasure" being not to her liking. No RESPONSIBILTY acknowledged on her part of what was a. "Prank" perhaps ? She again refused to return my call so I am reduced to this in order to be clear...Shes always been good at her job and pleasant so this is quite surprising ..Beware.

Christine is the sweetest person. She is the best hairdresser around she has done my hair for years if I'm not feeling well the day of my hair appointment I'm always feeling better by the time I leave there. Hope u have a blessed day. Love you. Patty

Absolutely the best hairdresser ever had! Christine took her time with my mom and was maticulous with her profession! I would recommend her for everyone that wants the best haircut, color, perm, etc. Christine is a kind and considerate person. Very unique experience!

She is always so considerate of her clients and very professional. But at the same time, becomes good friends with her clients. She is such a sweet and talented hairdresser. I have been going since I was born and I just graduated high school and am about to turn 18!
Christine is a joy to be around. I feel like a million bucks when she is done. My whole family and I drive from Weaverville just to get our hair done. So worth it!
The Best! Christine does excellent cuts...she listens to what you want and is very diligent to do just that. She is very sweet,sincerely cares about each customer.
Love Christine and love the way she does my hair. Have been going to her for over 20 years
I love how she really cares about what you want and takes the time to explain how it will look with your particular hair qualities.
My entire family goes to Christine. My kid since they were born. They are now 27 and 24 years old.
